abstract: INTRODUCTION: A perforating mediastinal mature teratoma can cause severe inflammation and adhesion; therefore, open surgery is usually performed. Asymptomatic perforation involving a teratoma is very rare. Complete thoracoscopic surgery is often difficult because of inflammation associated with perforation and the frequently large size of a mediastinal mature teratoma. We report a rare case of an asymptomatic perforating mediastinal mature teratoma successfully treated with complete thoracoscopic surgery. PRESENTATION OF CASE: The patient was a 15-year-old girl with an abnormal shadow at the mediastinum seen on chest radiography at a health examination performed at her junior high school; an asymptomatic mediastinal tumour was suspected. Enhanced computed tomography revealed a 6.5 × 3.5-cm tumour associated with the right upper lobe. Thoracoscopic surgery was performed using 4 access ports. Although there were inflammatory changes, hemi-thymectomy and right upper lobectomy were achieved with complete thoracoscopic surgery. The tumour included the skin, sebaceous glands, hair, and pancreatic tissue and was diagnosed as a mature teratoma perforating the right upper lobe. DISCUSSION: There might be limited inflammatory changes if the patient has few or no symptoms, as in our case. In such cases, the tumour may be excised even if it is large. CONCLUSION: We report a rare case of an asymptomatic perforating mediastinal mature teratoma that was successfully treated with complete thoracoscopic surgery. Although infection, inflammatory adhesion, large tumour size, and the need for radical cure are concerns, complete thoracoscopic surgery might be helpful. In cases of few or no symptoms, thoracoscopic surgery is worth challenging.
abstract_ja: はじめに：穿通性の縦隔成熟奇形腫は強い炎症や癒着を引き起こすため、通常は開胸手術が行われる。奇形腫による無症候性の穿通はきわめてまれである。穿通に伴う炎症や縦隔成熟奇形腫の大きさがしばしば大きいことから、完全胸腔鏡下手術は困難なことが多い。本稿では、無症候性の穿通性縦隔成熟奇形腫を完全胸腔鏡下手術で治療し得た、まれな症例を報告する。症例提示：患者は15歳の女児で、中学校での健康診断の胸部X線写真で縦隔に異常陰影が認められ、無症候性の縦隔腫瘍が疑われた。造影CTで、右上葉に関連する6.5×3.5cmの腫瘍が認められた。4つのポートを用いて胸腔鏡手術を行った。炎症性変化はあったものの、完全胸腔鏡下に半胸腺摘除術と右上葉切除術を達成した。腫瘍には皮膚、皮脂腺、毛髪、膵組織が含まれており、右上葉を穿通した成熟奇形腫と診断された。考察：本症例のように症状が少ないか無い場合には、炎症性変化が限定的である可能性がある。このような場合には、腫瘍が大きくても切除が可能なことがある。結論：無症候性の穿通性縦隔成熟奇形腫を完全胸腔鏡下手術で治療し得た、まれな症例を報告した。感染、炎症性癒着、腫瘍の大きさ、根治の必要性が懸念されるものの、完全胸腔鏡下手術は有用である可能性がある。症状が少ないか無い場合には、胸腔鏡手術を試みる価値がある。
